items.source: Creates a version from a String that matches Version.PATTERN; major, minor and revision numbers separated by dots with optional trailing characters.
items.translation: 根据与Version.PATTERN匹配的字符串创建版本；主要、次要和修订号之间用点分隔，并可选择带有尾部字符。
